description: This is the main React component file for the App, responsible for rendering and managing a multi-step UI for generating and editing a professional persona based on uploaded documents. It handles file uploads, orchestrates backend API calls for persona generation, displays progress, and allows editing of the persona data including profile image, skills, experiences, and highlights.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out non-string values and empty strings.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Attempts to map backend JSON data into the UI's PersonaData structure, using fallback data when necessary.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles file input change event, validating and adding files to the upload list.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds validated files to the uploaded files state, respecting maximum count.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default behavior for drag over events.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file from the uploaded files list by ID.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Initiates backend orchestration for persona draft generation, then polls for status updates.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves the current persona data as a new version via API call.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Sets the current persona as finalized.

methods.name: refreshVersions
methods.description: Fetches persona version history from backend.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a specified skill from the persona's skill list.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona's skill list.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles uploading and setting a new profile image.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing the file extension type.
